dedupe_keys.name: cartographie des ilots de fraicheur grand paris seine ouest cool spots map

description: This interactive map lists the places and devices that help residents keep cool during hot weather across Grand Paris Seine Ouest, the territorial body grouping communes west of Paris. GPSO built it on its open data platform in July 2023 and updated the page in July 2025. It shows public fountains and basins, drinking water points, misting devices, water activities along the Seine and green spaces, noting that parks, gardens and forests cover 39% of the territory and act as cool islands in summer. Coverage is the GPSO territory in the Hauts-de-Seine. Format and access: a public web map; the underlying open data layer was not read. Licence: not stated on the page read; free to view. Caveats: it is a public information map, so it records locations, not measured temperatures, and the fields behind it were not seen. It supports heatwave response planning and studies of green and blue spaces as heat refuges. A related catalogue record is Paris's cool green spaces dataset, a similar inventory for the neighbouring city.
